rationale: Stiven's deep expertise in computer vision, ML infrastructure, and embedded systems complements Georgi's focus on AI-agent automation workflows—Braillic's surgical navigation platform could benefit from GTM automation as they scale post-funding, while Rilo's no-code agent platform may find valuable use cases in medtech workflows. Georgi's hands-on approach to builder communities and GTM execution also aligns with Braillic's near-term need for engineering hires and FDA consulting support as they prepare for US market entry.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Georgi—you're both pushing AI agents into specialized domains (surgical AR and GTM automation), and your upcoming hiring and scaling needs could be a natural fit for Rilo's workflow automation approach.
